visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with short dark hair, wearing a black cap with white text and a black t-shirt, sits comfortably on a light grey fabric sofa. She holds a silver smartphone in her hands, looking down at the screen with a relaxed expression. The background consists of a plain off-white wall decorated with three small square posters featuring various graphics. The lighting is soft and even. (2) The scene transitions to a screen recording of a mobile application interface. The app displays various product listings, primarily purple and green track jackets with Evangelion Unit-01 themes. Price tags in NT$ are visible. The user's digital cursor navigates through the items, showcasing multiple variations and sizes. (3) The character returns to the screen, now in a medium shot. She has a pensive expression, with her hand resting on her chin and her eyes looking upwards as if making a decision. She wears the same black cap and t-shirt. The setting remains the same indoor living room environment with the grey sofa. (4) A rapid montage shows a cluttered floor area filled with various colorful children's toys, including a red toy car, a plastic corn toy, and small plushies. The next shot shows a shelf displaying several boxed and unboxed figurines, notably a purple Evangelion Unit-01 figure positioned prominently in a corner. (5) The character is shown in a close-up, wearing the black cap. She holds a white shipping package with a red Mercari logo. She looks directly at the camera with an excited and determined expression, gesturing with her hands. (6) A transition to the character unboxing the package on the grey sofa. She pulls out a purple garment wrapped in clear plastic. A small hand-written note on white paper with Japanese text is attached to the plastic wrapping. She handles the item with care, showcasing the packaging. (7) Detailed close-up shots of the purple jacket are shown. The fabric texture is visible, and the intricate green and orange embroidered design of an anime robot head on the back is highlighted. The camera pans across the stitching and the collar of the garment. (8) The character is seen wearing the purple and green track jacket. She stands and turns to show the large graphic on the back. She puts her hands in the jacket pockets and poses confidently for the camera, smiling. The background is a plain white studio wall. (9) Another screen recording session of the Mercari app interface. The user enters a search term in Traditional Chinese. The screen populates with a diverse range of merchandise. Promotional banners for a shopping festival are visible at the top. (10) A series of yellow and red graphic cards fill the screen, detailing promotional offers. Text includes '11.11' and mentions of '1折' coupons for new users. Icons of various consumer items are used as decorative elements in the graphic. (11) The character appears again, pointing towards a screen overlay showing a registration page and an invitation code field. A red box highlights where the code should be entered. She looks at the camera and speaks enthusiastically. (12) The final shot shows the character in the purple jacket, making an energetic fist-pumping gesture. A 'fire' emoji graphic appears next to her as she smiles broadly towards the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, energetic female voice speaking rapidly in Traditional Chinese. The vocal tone is friendly and animated. Simultaneously, a cheerful, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a bright synthesizer melody and a steady drum beat starts. The background noise floor is low. (2) A short, bright 'pop' sound effect occurs as the narrator describes the digital shopping interface. The BGM maintains its upbeat energy. The female voice exhibits high pitch variability and rising intonations as she expresses excitement about the discovered anime merchandise. (3) The acoustic texture shifts slightly with the addition of fabric rustling sounds and the crinkling of plastic. These incidental noises are sharp but clear against the music. The narrator's voice becomes more projected and louder during an emphatic exclamation about otaku culture. (4) A 'whoosh' transition sound effect marks the shift to the garment unboxing. The BGM remains constant, providing a rhythmic base. The voice continues with high articulation clarity, detailing the physical quality of the second-hand item. No other background voices are present. (5) A distinct 'ding' sound effect accompanies the visual mention of promotional coupons. The narrator's speech rate remains fast. The spectral balance of the track is bright, with clear highs and a balanced mid-range for the vocal clarity. (6) The BGM continues with high energy during the call-to-action phase. The narrator uses a persuasive and authoritative yet friendly tone. A final 'fwoosh' synthesizer sweep SFX concludes the audio track as the voice stops. The overall signal quality is pristine.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Personal Conflict -> Solution/App Introduction -> Unboxing Review -> Feature Tutorial -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video promotes the Japanese second-hand marketplace app 'Mercari' to a Chinese-speaking audience, focusing on the 11.11 shopping event. It uses the creator's personal interest in Evangelion merchandise to demonstrate the app's cross-border shipping and promotional benefits.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of Mercari, walkthrough of its features, display of specific 11.11 coupons, and provision of a personal referral code 'SWHITEW11'.
